name: Tony Revolori
bio:
Anthony Revolori (né Quiñonez; born April 28, 1996) is a Guatemalan-American actor. He is best known for his collaborations with Wes Anderson starring in The Grand Budapest Hotel (2014), The French Dispatch (2021), and Asteroid City (2023) and for portraying Flash Thompson in the Marvel Cinematic Universe films Spider-Man: Homecoming (2017), Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), and Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021). Born and raised in California, USA to Guatemalan parents. His father was an actor in his youth.
